versions.subject: windows and linux python pty spawning
versions.detection:
selection_image:
    Image|re: '/python(\d(\.\d{1,2})?)?$'  # python image is always of the form ../python3.10; ../python is just a symlink
selection_cli1:
    CommandLine|contains|all:
        - 'import pty'
        - '.spawn('
selection_cli2:
    CommandLine|contains: 'from pty import spawn'
condition: selection_image and 1 of selection_cli*
versions.spl: (CommandLine="*import pty*" CommandLine="*.spawn(*") OR CommandLine="*from pty import spawn*" | regex Image="/python(\\d(\\.\\d{1,2})?)?$"
